title: M³-AVM: Multimodal Multi-Model Abstract Virtual Machine
description:
M³-AVM is a deterministic virtual machine prototype in Rust for sparse event-driven tensor computation. This record archives the source tree (code, ISA specs, machine-checked proofs); model weights are NOT included (see Notes). Implements: 32-byte fixed ISA v1.5 (control/thinking loop, GEMV blocks, Mamba/SSM + audio codec, local cluster ops, GATHER/DISTANCE/RANK1_UPDATE, FOREST, DENOISE/ODE/SPIKE/CONV steps, KV_TRUNCATE, SLICE, seeded RNG + hashing, telemetry/scheduler, immediates), strict-priority scheduler with deadlines, CoW snapshot/rollback with monotonic versions and retention window, CSR sparse tensors, Q4_K fused AVX2 matvec, GGUF mmap inference with per-layer KV cache, criterion benches for the hybrid opcodes, and Lean 4 proofs (SSM, rollback, windowed error). Normative spec: docs/ESPEC.md. Distributed transport, hardware accelerators and remaining universal-AI waves are reserved future work.

Notes: (1) Model weights (*.gguf, incl. PersonaPlex-7B Q4_K) are git-ignored and not part of this archive; download sources are listed in docs/arq/MOSHI_MAP.md and docs/arq/PLANO_MOSHI_NATIVO.md. (2) One pre-existing test failure unrelated to the spec (moshi norm-gamma assertion on local weights) is documented in docs/ESPEC.md §16.
